name: Shawn Kawabe
location: São Paulo, Brazil, working remotely with US and Brazilian clients
headline: CRM solutions that teams actually adopt.
intro: I design and build them, from **Lightning Web Components** and **Apex** to SAP integrations, Data Cloud and data migrations, always grounded in Salesforce best practices.
bio: I'm a Senior Salesforce Developer and Functional Specialist with a Bachelor's in Computer Science from Centro Universitário FEI. I've delivered Salesforce work for automotive, agribusiness, financial services, food, education and communications companies.

I work across the whole delivery: gathering requirements with business teams, modeling data, building with declarative and programmatic tools, integrating with ERPs and cloud services, and documenting so the next team can carry it forward.

principles.title: Best practices first
principles.body: Declarative before programmatic, bulkified code, clear sharing models, and tests that mean something.

principles.title: Understand the process
principles.body: I map the business process before choosing objects, flows or components.

principles.title: Documentation is a deliverable
principles.body: Technical designs and knowledge-transfer material ship with the code.

principles.title: Reusable by default
principles.body: Components and services built to be reused across teams and orgs.
